title: Get help now
intro: If your pet may have eaten something harmful, call for help now. Don't wait for signs.
ownVetBody: Usually the fastest option, and free. Out of hours, their phone line often gives an emergency number.
noneForRegion: We don't have a checked poison line for this region yet. Call your own vet, or find an emergency vet below.
fee_animal_poisonline_gb: £35 to £45 per case, paid by card when you call
